If D=0 the Ddot=alpha N term forces N=0, contradicting Ndot=a1>0. Printed E02=(a1/d1,0,0,0,0,0) has Ndot=-alpha*a1/d1 and Ddot=+alpha*a1/d1. Exact Jacobian factorization gives four strictly negative scalar eigenvalues and infectious quadratic (lambda+k)(lambda+d6)-beta*e*a3*D0. For R>1 it has a positive real root; for R<1 both roots have negative real parts; at R=1 nonhyperbolic only. Explicit apoptosis-dominant rates a_i=1, d_i=2, alpha=gamma=mu=e=1, beta=20 give R=5/3 and positive root -2+sqrt(20/3). A fresh independent SymPy Jacobian reconstruction verified polynomial and witness. The claimed clearance-conditional D->D0 follows stable scalar forcing.
